Agenda 2030 / global-governance route

Track migration as human cost, policy route, NGO route, border contractor route and political signal.

Sources to check

CBP/DHS, Frontex, Eurostat, Home Office, UNHCR, IOM.

Evidence class

Public-record lane

Update discipline

Weekly by default; faster during official releases, elections, filings, court events, crisis or sanctions changes.

Conclusion

  • Migration claims need definitions before conclusions.

Boundary

Agenda 2030 / SDG / global-governance alignment is tracked as public-record policy alignment, not as proof of wrongdoing by itself.
